description: Gate guardian mounted on a steel pylon behind the perimeter wall of the Ghana Air Force Officers Mess in Accra and clearly visible from the street. Serial G706 read directly off the rear fuselage in a dated photograph of 29 August 2010 (LudwigJoelAdjete on Wikimedia Commons), which also shows the Ghana flag on the fin and roundels on fuselage and tip tanks. A distinct airframe from G707 at Kumasi. Currency beyond 2010 is unverified and no coordinate has been established for the mess, so the site record carries no coordinate.
museum_name: Ghana Air Force Officers Mess Accra
